method: Hand labels made by reading each repository at its pinned commit, before Refit was run on any of them on this branch (the 2026-10-21 census results were not consulted). Candidates: every JS/TS line outside test, example, story, dist and build paths that quotes a Gemini-shaped ID (gemini-…, optionally models/…). Sample: mulberry32(20261022) order over the 50 frozen repositories, first 20 with at most 60 candidate lines. The labeller is the agent that wrote the Gemini tracers in this lane.

scope.sent: The code can send this literal as the model to a Gemini or Vertex AI endpoint: a fixed model, a default, an environment or option fallback. `via` is `sdk` when the request goes through @google/genai, @google/generative-ai or @google-cloud/vertexai (Refit's tracers), `other` for any other client (Vercel AI SDK, raw fetch, WebSocket, other gateways).
scope.not-sent: Catalogs and model lists, type unions, pricing and capability tables, comparisons and prefix checks, comments and docs, product or resource IDs that only look like models, test and example code in paths the candidate filter keeps, and defaults every caller overrides.
scope.ambiguous: Paths that could not be settled by reading; not scored.
